subject: Re: Explainable routing kickoff: 'why is my route different today?'
body:
Anders,

Resourcing for the window.

Milan 60% on the build productionization and service scaffolding, Gustavo 50% on the scenario tooling and the subgraph caching (cached subgraphs are what make repeated runs fast, so that layer needs to be solid), Wei 30% advising on eval methodology. The anchor: Rafael Duran is committed at 60% for May 2026 to drive the explanation-quality evaluation and the scenario-generation extensions - I've booked him at that level in the allocation sheet. The May 29 eval-framework milestone is his deliverable.

Compute: trivial by portfolio standards - this is CPU-bound graph computation. The one infra ask is a beefy-memory batch tier for the Washington-region runs; loading is much faster with compiler optimizations (Release build) but memory is the constraint.

Risk: the partner-shaped scenario set doesn't exist yet, and Rafael can't start eval design against it until Gustavo's generator handles partner road-network densities. Sequencing is tight in early May.

Daniela
